title: N -W F P Agricultural Produce Markets Repeal Ordinance 2002

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Agricultural Produce Markets Repeal Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Short title commencement

ORDINANCE XXXVIII OF 2002
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE AGRICULTURAL PRODUCE MARKETS (REPEAL) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XXXVIII OF
2002
An Ordinance to
repeal the Agricultural Produce Markets Act, 1939
[Gazette of N.-W.
F. P., Extraordinary, 5th October, 2002]
No.LEGIS.1(4)/94/7351, dated
15-10-2002. The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West
Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:-
1. Short title commencement.--(1)
This Ordinance may be called the North-West Frontier Province Agricultural Produce
Markets (Repeal) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

ORDINANCE XXXVIII OF 2002
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE AGRICULTURAL PRODUCE MARKETS (REPEAL) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XXXVIII OF
2002
An Ordinance to
repeal the Agricultural Produce Markets Act, 1939
[Gazette of N.-W.
F. P., Extraordinary, 5th October, 2002]
No.LEGIS.1(4)/94/7351, dated
15-10-2002. The following Ordinance by the Governor of the North-West
Frontier Province is hereby published for general information:-
2. Repeal of Punjab Act No. V
of 1939.--The Agricultural Produce Markets Act, 1939, in its application to the North-West
Frontier Province, is hereby repealed.
